note: In the ledger, `sources` holds indices into `sources` below, and method fields hold indices into `methods`.
methods: Guard exact bytes of only files actually written, full canonical before/after rows and field presence/type/value. Preserve all other fields, row order, JSON indentation, key order and terminal newline. Any later master with byte-identical guarded files is accepted, regardless of HEAD. Validate all outputs before writing; use staged atomic replacement and rollback on write failure.

Only population/year facts of the unchanged same entity are admitted. The original row type/type_local and parent, point within 5 km of its own item, own names/native and current P31/P131 are checked. Official code (KATO / Moroccan commune / CUATM where present), table unit label and source state jointly bind a unique unit. City administration, district, commune, municipality and seat are separate scopes. Geostat Borough means a separate townlet: only its own same-name settlement count is selected, never a citywide total or a municipality total. Shared names, items, counts or point proximity alone do not admit a row. Ambiguity stays held.

Use only the five screened official datasets. Quote the exact deciding terms clause in source metadata and each contributing office credit block, with source and terms links and explicit changes/rounding. The separately restricted Malaysian local-authority PDF contributes no value or identity proof.

Use only the screened office editions and their reference years: KZ 1 July 2026; MA 1 September 2024; GE 1 January 2026; MD 8 April 2024 census; MY 2026 mid-year (CSV date is an annual label). A stored newer population year, or own-item dated P1082 claim equal to the stored count after the source reference, blocks replacement. A matching count gets only its year. No absent source row implies zero.

Every GE Abkhazia row and named South Ossetia row, every MD Transnistria/Bender/Chițcani row and any MA Western Sahara point or whole overlapping Assa-Zag/Tan-Tan provincial candidate is held scope. No EH row is read or changed. Special-area inclusion cannot be inferred from the population table.
